photo_cleanup_delay_hint: Days after compression before photos are permanently deleted.
photo_confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete this submission?
photo_max_size_error: Total size exceeds 40 MB limit. Please select fewer or smaller photos.
photo_retention_days_hint: How many days before photos are compressed and notified via email.
photo_retention_explain: After the retention period expires, photos are compressed and a notification is sent by email. After the cleanup delay, they are permanently deleted.
